findings.title: Autocorrect correction-chip Undo at a sentence start restores the capitalized form instead of the typed text
findings.repro: New paragraph, type 'qwe ' (custom pair qwe = qtt) -> becomes 'Qtt ' with correction chip; click chip 'Undo' -> 'Qwe ' remains (typed text was 'qwe'). Same with pair zqx = zqxfixed -> 'Zqx '.
findings.expected: Undo restores the exact typed text 'qwe' (control: mid-sentence 'mid qwe ' -> 'qtt' -> Undo -> exact 'qwe')
findings.control: mid-sentence immediate Undo restores exact lowercase (pass)
findings.source: app-js.txt proofReverse84 -> proofApplyTarget84(last.target, last.original); proofLast84.original recorded at replacement time, after the sentence-capitalization correction already rewrote the first letter; single-level undo cannot revert the earlier capitalization; proofSessionIgnore84.add(original) already prevents re-fire so exact restore was feasible
findings.impact: one-character case fidelity loss on the revert affordance; fix: record the pre-capitalization original or revert both corrections

findings.title: Autocorrect correction chip keeps offering Undo after further typing but the click silently does nothing
findings.repro: Type 'definately more words ' -> 'Definitely more words ' with chip visible; click chip 'Undo' -> text unchanged, chip just disappears. Also reproduced with 'zqx undo test ' -> 'Zqxfixed undo test ' unchanged after Undo click.
findings.expected: chip either hides once invalidated, or Undo still reverts the correction (Word smart-tag behavior)
findings.control: immediate Undo (no further typing) reverts successfully
findings.source: app-js.txt proofReverse84 first guard: last.state!==Undo.last -> proofClearCorrection84(); return false - chip is not hidden on invalidation
findings.classification: CANDIDATE (design intent of the 5s affordance window uncertain; broken affordance is concrete)
findings.impact: misleading undo affordance for ~5s after a correction; fix: hide chip when Undo.last changes
